summary: Appends string a2 to a growable string buffer: buffer pointer at this+0x0, capacity at this+0x4. If the buffer holds an existing string and its capacity is smaller than the combined length, allocates a new buffer via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, copies the old content, frees the old buffer with FreeWrapper_7bcf and updates pointer/capacity, then strcat-appends a2. If the buffer is empty it delegates to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a2). Widely called by file/path loaders and UI setup paths.

local_names.v5: combined length without terminators = v4 - 1 + v3 - 1

operations.description: If a2 is null, do nothing.
If the buffer pointer at this+0x0 is non-null, take the in-place concat path; otherwise delegate to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a2).
v3 = strlen(*this) + 1; v4 = strlen(a2) + 1; v5 = v4 - 1 + v3 - 1, the combined content length (excludes the null terminators).
If capacity at this+0x4 is less than the combined length v5, reallocate.
Reallocation: v6 = OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(v4 + v3 - 1); strcpy(v6, *this); FreeWrapper_7bcf(*this); *this = v6; this+0x4 = v5.
Append: strcat(*(char**)this, a2) after ensuring capacity.
Empty-buffer path: StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a2) allocates and copies the string into the buffer.
